co2_content_interior.conclusion: 03FE is the not-fitted sentinel: 40/40 passive/live rows and the same sentinel in cell_t_18..cell_t_23. Do not decode it as 1,022 ppm or 25,400 ppm.

energy_content.field_notes: 0x2AB2 uses bytes 0:2 x50; 0x2AB8 uses bytes 2:4 x25 (Car Scanner [19.Gate]).

0x04A3.status: same payload as 0x2A26 in this capture

odometer_counter.conclusion: The counter is 10 km/LSB. On this car it is the main odometer minus about 99,870 km (observed 99,869-99,871 km, within the two counters' rounding); that constant offset is consistent with a BMS replacement/reset at ~99,870 km, but service history is not available.

windshield_temperature.conclusion: The two-byte profile formula gives implausible values; byte 0 x0.1 tracks outside temperature within a few degrees. Windshield-vs-ambient identity still needs the cold-soak/defroster test.

extraction.method: ELF/RFCOMM printable lines -> ISO-TP SF/FF/CF reassembly -> UDS 0x62

source.note: Raw btsnoop is not committed: it contains unrelated phone data. Only CAN id/DID/payload records selected by tools/mine_passive_capture.py are retained here. Timestamps are offsets from the first btsnoop record.
